To perform certain actions when you use a gesture, such as locking your phone, Lawnchair requires accessibility access.

Lawnchair doesn't watch your actions, though all accessibility services require this privilege. Lawnchair discards any event sent by the system.

To lock your phone or open the Recents screen, Lawnchair uses the performGlobalAction accessibility service.
